description:
One command that adds the chosen Beamline elements and a look (default prism) to the app: only those packages, one stylesheet and the look.
Pass every element the screens need in one call; call it again to add more later. Run the command in the app folder, import the stylesheet once and pass the installed look to UIRoot. In an app that already has Beamline, pass installed (its release): the answer says when a newer one is out. Elements outside the person's packs are refused, naming the pack that has them.

ids.description: Every element the screens need, by id from beamline_capabilities.

installed.description: The Beamline release the app already uses, if any: acceptedRelease.version in .beamline/package-selection.json (beamline-ui.lock.json for editable source). The answer then says when a newer one is out.

look.description: prism, soft, blueprint, glass, metal, glow, pop, mono or ink (default prism: black, neutral glass, white main action).

source.description: True for every Beamline file as editable source in the app, including runtime, foundation, selected looks and fonts; no @beamline dependencies. Needs Tailwind v4. Default false: compiled packages.

name: beamline_install
